summary.intent: Add all missing facet and session data to the summary TUI detail pane, which currently shows only a subset of the available SQLite data for each checkpoint.
summary.outcome: A design spec was written and saved to docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-03-summary-tui-enhanced-detail-design.md, with a compact grouped layout (4 boxes: SUMMARY, CODE, LEARNINGS, SIGNALS) agreed upon. An implementation plan was started via the writing-plans skill.

repo: The insights.db SQLite database has 16 tables; sessions (2,633 rows), tool_calls (16,029), files_touched (10,788), learnings (2,269), friction (616), codebase_patterns (422), implementation_rationale (333), tradeoffs (248), review_rule_signals (212), missing_context_signals (189), repeated_user_instructions (103), failure_loops (102), skill_signals (55), suggestions (0), cache_meta (1).

Facets are LLM-extracted structured signals from session transcripts. Backfilling means finding sessions with has_facets=0, condensing their transcripts, sending to LLM for extraction, writing to facet tables, then marking has_facets=1.

The summary TUI detail pane is in cmd/entire/cli/summarytui/detail_page.go. The SessionRow struct contains many fields not currently rendered: token breakdown, scores, files touched, tool counts, implementation rationale, tradeoffs, codebase patterns, and facet evidence fields.
Facet types include: friction, failure loops, repeated user instructions, missing context signals, skill signals, review rule signals, repo gotchas, workflow gaps.
The brainstorming skill can launch a visual companion server at http://localhost:65000 for rendering HTML mockups during design sessions.

code.finding: Currently renders SESSION, TOKENS, SUMMARY, FRICTION, LEARNINGS, INSIGHTS boxes. Missing: token breakdown, scores, stats, files touched, tool counts, implementation rationale, tradeoffs, codebase patterns, and per-facet evidence fields.
Contains all facet struct definitions including evidence fields on repeated instructions, missing context, failure loops, skill signals, and review rules.

workflow: The Codex adversarial review companion script hits ENOBUFS on large repos — git diff output exceeds its internal buffer. Not viable for large repos regardless of foreground/background mode.
The brainstorming skill supports a visual companion server for HTML mockups, which is useful for TUI layout design decisions.

friction: Codex adversarial review script (codex-companion.mjs) hit ENOBUFS on both foreground and background runs due to repo size; the review could not complete.
The Codex companion's buffer limitation means adversarial review is blocked for this repo.
